label: Neurotransmission and signaling
scope: synapses, classic vs retrograde/volume neurotransmission, signal transduction cascades, second messengers, kinases, downstream gene expression triggered by receptors

label: Genes, epigenetics and neurodevelopment
scope: genes, epigenetics, neurodevelopment, synapse formation/pruning, neurotrophic factors, risk genes

label: Transporters and VMAT2
scope: monoamine transporters (SERT, NET, DAT), VMAT, VMAT2 inhibitors as a mechanism, GABA/glycine transporters, reuptake mechanics

label: G-protein receptors and the agonist spectrum
scope: GPCR structure, agonist/partial agonist/antagonist/inverse agonist spectrum, allosteric modulation, binding, receptor up/down-regulation

label: Ion channels
scope: ligand-gated channels as structures, voltage-sensitive sodium/calcium channels, α2δ ligands as a mechanism, HCN, channel coupling

label: Pharmacokinetics, CYP450 and interactions
scope: CYP450 enzymes, inducers/inhibitors, half-life, dosing forms, LAIs, drug interactions, serotonin syndrome as an interaction

label: Circuits and symptom-based prescribing
scope: brain circuits (prefrontal, striatal, thalamic loops), mapping symptoms to circuits, symptom-based treatment selection, when no more specific topic fits

label: Dopamine
scope: dopamine synthesis, pathways (mesolimbic, mesocortical, nigrostriatal, tuberoinfundibular), dopamine receptors and hypotheses

label: Serotonin
scope: serotonin synthesis, 5HT receptor subtypes and their effects, serotonin-dopamine interactions, 5HT circuits

label: Norepinephrine and α2 receptors
scope: NE synthesis, locus coeruleus, α1/α2/β receptors, α2 agonists as a mechanism

label: Glutamate and NMDA receptors
scope: glutamate, NMDA/AMPA/mGlu receptors, NMDA hypofunction, ketamine/esketamine mechanism, excitotoxicity

label: GABA, benzodiazepines and neurosteroids
scope: GABA synthesis, GABA-A subtypes (synaptic/extrasynaptic), benzodiazepines, Z-drugs mechanism, neurosteroids (brexanolone, zuranolone)

label: Acetylcholine
scope: ACh synthesis, muscarinic and nicotinic receptors, cholinesterase inhibitors as a mechanism, anticholinergic effects in general

label: Histamine, orexin and arousal
scope: histamine and H1/H3 receptors, orexin/hypocretin, arousal systems, orexin antagonists and wake-promoters as mechanisms

label: Opioid and endocannabinoid systems
scope: opioid receptors and peptides, endocannabinoids, CB1/CB2, opioid pharmacology regardless of chapter

label: Psychosis and schizophrenia
scope: psychosis spectrum, schizophrenia symptoms and course, psychosis in other disorders (Parkinson's, dementia), neurobiological hypotheses applied to psychosis

label: Antipsychotics: binding and individual drugs
scope: how antipsychotics work, receptor binding profiles, D2 occupancy, individual first/second/third-generation agents, clozapine, pimavanserin, treatment choice in psychosis

label: Antipsychotic side effects
scope: EPS, tardive dyskinesia and its treatment, NMS, prolactin, metabolic and cardiometabolic risk, sedation, motor side effects

label: Depression and the mood spectrum
scope: unipolar and bipolar depression as disorders, mood spectrum, mixed features, mania as a syndrome, neurobiology of mood

label: Antidepressants and augmentation
scope: SSRIs, SNRIs, NDRIs, MAOIs, TCAs, multimodal agents, rapid-acting antidepressants, augmentation and treatment-resistant depression strategies

label: Lithium and mood stabilizers
scope: lithium, valproate, lamotrigine, carbamazepine, other anticonvulsants as mood stabilizers, bipolar treatment strategy

label: Anxiety, fear and trauma
scope: anxiety disorders, fear conditioning and extinction, amygdala, PTSD, treatment of anxiety

label: Chronic pain
scope: nociception, central sensitization, descending pathways, fibromyalgia, neuropathic pain treatment

label: Sleep, wake and circadian rhythm
scope: insomnia, hypersomnia, narcolepsy, circadian rhythm disorders, sleep treatments, sleep architecture

label: ADHD and stimulants
scope: ADHD symptoms and circuits, stimulants (methylphenidate, amphetamine), non-stimulant ADHD treatments, tonic/phasic firing in ADHD

label: Dementia and its behavioral symptoms
scope: Alzheimer's and other dementias, amyloid/tau, cognitive treatments, agitation and psychosis in dementia

label: Substance use and reward
scope: reward circuit, stimulants/nicotine/alcohol/opioid/cannabis/hallucinogen use disorders and their treatments

label: Impulsivity and compulsivity
scope: impulsivity vs compulsivity circuits, OCD, eating disorders, gambling, behavioral addictions, impulse-control disorders
